continuation: Exact Experiment 25 periodic repair at ORIGINAL reset prefixes; alternative single interventions

ridge.scaling: training-only weighted mean/population SD; SD<=1e-12 -> 1; mean-one weights

decision: prediction>1e-12 REFRESH; prediction<-1e-12 HOLD; otherwise original Periodic action

hog.orientation: unsigned [0,pi); linear circular bin interpolation; no spatial interpolation
hog.initialization: zero gradient -> zero descriptor; candidate zero initializes both references; refresh reference updated after anchor decision
hog.transitions: row-major 16 L2 from last actually refreshed thumbnail, then row-major 16 from previous candidate

grayscale: Exact unmodified causal_observability_policy.cheap_signal on PyAV reformat(width=32,height=32,format=gray)
evaluation_weights: class -> class-family -> clip -> mean of 12 reset-state consequences; fold subsets restrict and renormalize full weights
training_weights: same hierarchy recomputed using only training partition; rescale to mean one

arms.A: Fresh encoded-file read + CPU full decode + authenticated presentation/grid path
arms.B: A + earlier refreshed history construction + held-out ridge H scoring
arms.C: A + history + all16 grayscale conversion/statistics + held-out ridge HG scoring
arms.D: A + history + all16 grayscale/HOG acquisition + held-out ridge HGH scoring

timing.disk_cache: OS cache not flushed; fresh byte read and fresh decode each trial; no decoded-frame reuse
timing.repetitions_collapsed: Within-clip median of paired repetition differences; summarize median and p95 across 60 clips

decision_rules.promising: ridge delta_HOG>=.01 AND V(HGH)>0 AND >=4 favorable folds AND paired median D-A<=10ms
decision_rules.deprioritize: V(HGH)<=0 OR ridge delta_HOG<0 OR paired median D-A>10ms

uncertainty: Finite cohort and fold stability; no bootstrap CI, no confirmatory inference; no equivalence or impossibility claims
